title: Testing arimoclomol in HEXA-related disease cells

sentences.text: This is a hypothesis, not a finding: its weakest link is whether protein destabilization / misfolding drives HEXA-related disorders strongly enough to support this approach.
Test whether arimoclomol improves a disease-relevant readout in cells, compared with cells without arimoclomol.
Use the published patient-cell work as the starting point: pyrimethamine partly rescued many variants, with increased lysosomal enzyme protein and activity.
The lab would need to establish a suitable HEXA-related patient-cell model and these measurements before testing arimoclomol.
Measure lysosomal Hex A enzyme protein and activity with and without arimoclomol, following the readouts reported in the patient-cell rescue work.
Include cells without arimoclomol and a pyrimethamine comparison to check whether rescue can be detected in the selected model.

sections.heading: What result would change the plan

sentences.text: Rescue would justify further cell-based confirmation, not patient treatment; no effect with a working rescue comparison would support retiring this link.
If the rescue comparison fails, revisit the model and measurements before interpreting arimoclomol.
Arimoclomol’s proposed mechanism is contested, and its clinical mechanism in NPC is unknown.
The shared mechanism is not disease-specific, symptom overlap with NPC1-related disease is minimal, and the graph contains no test of this therapy class in HEXA-related disease.
